map.高展弦比（滑翔机可达 30+）诱导阻力小、巡航效率高，但结构长细比大、机翼重、不: A high aspect ratio (gliders can reach 30 and above) gives low induced drag and high cruise efficiency, but a slender structure and heavy wings suit low speed poorly; a low aspect ratio (fighters 2-4) is structurally strong and suits high-speed manoeuvring, but has high induced drag and short range. The choice trades cruise efficiency against manoeuvrability and speed.

This sits at the lower end of the common 7-9 range for transport aircraft, meaning the wing is relatively short and thick with slightly higher induced drag but a lighter structure.
